newsitem.title: USA: EA Industries to sell stake in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: EA Industries to sell stake in joint venture.

text.p: EA Industries, a diversified contract electronics manufacturer, said Thursday it has refocused its efforts on its core business and intends to sell its interest in a joint venture with Israel Aircraft Industries.

The company disclosed the plan as it reported a net loss of $29.9 million for 1996 or $6.24 a share, on net sales of $81.6 million. The results compare with a net loss of $30.894 million in 1995 or $10.01 a share, on net sales of $77.085 million.

The company said its financial projections indicate that operating losses and negative cash flows will continue during the first half of 1997, but it should return to profitability in the second half of 1997.
Company chairman Irwin Gross said that in 1996, the company realized that its future was in electronic congtracgt manufacturing.
"There are significant opportunities in this industry and we are disposing of our other interests to concentrate there," he said.
At the same time, he said that the company was in the process of putting together additional financing to strengthen its balance sheet and suport its electronics contract manufacturing subsidiary.
